Musician Daryl Davis and former neo-Nazi Jeff Schoep share episode 2399 of the Joe Rogan Experience, a stunning pairing. Davis, a Black blues pianist, is famous for befriending Ku Klux Klan members and persuading many to leave. Schoep once led America's largest neo-Nazi group before quitting it.

Davis explains how honest talk across hate changed men that protests could not. Schoep tells how he rose inside the movement and what finally broke its hold on him. Rogan guides a dialogue few shows could host. Hopeful and brave listeners get proof that conversation can pull people back from the edge.
